newsitem.title: FINLAND: NOKIA NO 1 IN DIGITAL HANDSETS '95 - PAPER.
newsitem.headline: NOKIA NO 1 IN DIGITAL HANDSETS '95 - PAPER.

text.p: Finnish telecommunications group Nokia Oy's digital mobile phone handsets were the best selling in the world in 1995, daily Helsingin Sanomat reported on Saturday.
Nokia's share of all digital handsets sold to consumers was 25.1 percent in 1995, Helsingin Sanomat said, quoting research firm Dataquest.

Motorola , which was the market leader in digital handsets in 1994, but fell to the second place in 1995 with 24.9 percent of all digital handsets, while Swedish Ericsson was the third with 16.8 percent of the market and German Siemens was the fourth with 7.5 percent.
Of all digital and analog handsets sold in 1995, Motorola produced 30.8 percent, while Nokia made 23.1 percent and Ericsson made 10.7 percent, the paper said.
